pattern: を禁じ得ない（をきんじえない）
purpose: Describe an emotion that cannot be held back.
keywords: Emotion noun + を禁じ得ない
I cannot help feeling astonished by the sudden closure.
I could not suppress my anger at the irresponsible response.
I could not hold back tears at the reunion.
formation: Emotion noun + を禁じ得ない
restrictions: Common with 驚き, 怒り, 同情, and 涙.
mistake: It is an involuntary emotional response, not an explicit ban.
